title: Push humanize time formatting past 80 percent kill rate
goal: mutmut==2.4.4 with parso==0.8.4 generates exactly 326 mutants in the installed humanize/time.py of humanize==4.9.0. An 80 percent kill rate demands exhaustive boundary work on naturaldelta, naturaltime, naturalday, naturaldate, and precisedelta: unit rollover points (seconds/minutes/hours/days/months/years), future versus past phrasing, minimum_unit and suppress combinations, and month approximation arithmetic -- always with explicit datetime or timedelta values and an explicit when argument, never the wall clock, or the suite becomes flaky and a red baseline disqualifies. The mutation residue at 80 percent sits in off-by-one threshold mutants, so the campaign lives or dies on reading survivor diffs and constructing inputs that straddle each mutated boundary. Fail-closed grading: red baseline, suite slower than 4 seconds, source-introspection tokens, or mutant-total drift scores kill_rate -1.
resources: pypi humanize==4.9.0 (target under mutation: humanize/time.py natural-language time deltas)
pypi mutmut==2.4.4 + parso==0.8.4 (deterministic mutant generation; all transitive deps pinned in assets/gc-358/config.json)
pypi pytest==8.2.2 (only permitted test framework; plugin autoload disabled at grading time)
files under assets/gc-358/ (sealed grader grade.py + config.json with expected mutant totals)
process_expectations: A behavior-inventory plan exists at work/gc-358/plan.md, written before the first grading run, mapping the target module's behaviors to planned test groups.
At least two full grading runs are logged under work/gc-358/logs/ as raw grader JSON lines, and the survivor count decreases between the first and the last run.
Surviving mutants are tracked by mutant ID (mutmut result-ids / mutmut show) at work/gc-358/survivors.md, each with a verdict of killable-next or suspected-equivalent -- identities, not just counts.
Every RED or disqualified grading run is recorded with its cause and the concrete recovery action taken; no silent retries.
An honest per-iteration log of wall-clock and LLM spend exists at work/gc-358/cost_log.md, including failed iterations.
